name: on_place
title: players.on_place
lead: Asks `fn` before a player puts a block down; return false to cancel it. A missed deadline denies the place.
signature: players.on_place(fn: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3, block: string) -> boolean ?) → Connection

params.name: fn
params.type: (player: Player ?, pos: Vec3 , block: string ) -> boolean

usedIn.quote: Placing it fires `players.on_place`, then the block's `on_place` with the
`players.on_break` and `players.on_place` run **before** the world changes. A
players.on_place(function(player, pos, block) return false end) -> connection
